mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at 35 degrees near Verona Area High School under the glow of a full moon.

City news highlights include candidate registration information for the 2027 Spring Election; please note that candidacy paperwork must be submitted to the City Clerk by January 5, 2027. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15, and payments can be made online, by mail, or via the drop boxes at the City Center.

There is plenty to do in town: Yoga at Insight Wellness and ART House 360 events are happening today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to Hop Haus Trivia, live music at Bailey's Run, and a 50th-anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On November 2, officers were dispatched to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Culver's of Verona will be opening today at 10:00 AM, featuring today's flavor of the day, which is z.
